'''Minister of Intelligence''' was the highest position a non-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] could achieve within the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agency. As Minister, an individual headed up the largest espionage and intelligence agency in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] under the directives of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of the [[Dark Council]]. In spite of this, however, the Minister possessed a certain degree of autonomy, able to retain total control of their organization, so long as it represented Sith interests.

==History==
The Minister of intelligence was the historic position given to the director of the agency. For centuries, the ministers were known for running the bureaucracy with the utmost efficiency.

[[Minister of Intelligence (Cold War)|A man]] served in this position during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], operating under the supervision of Dark Council member [[Darth Jadus]] and later his daughter, [[Darth Zhorrid]]. The spymaster known as [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Keeper]] served beneath the Minister of Intelligence as the head of [[Operations Division]] and was eventually promoted to the position himself.

However, in light of the recent [[Star Cabal]] crisis and the ensuing closure of the organization in [[3640 BBY]], the position of minister was abolished, the new [[Sith Intelligence]] instead reporting directly to the [[Dark Council]].
